cases.statement: One person: patient 46 (family 29) in a Japanese national survey; heterozygous (stated for all 54 patients). Survey tables only, no case narrative.

people.label: P46
people.key_phenotypes: onset 5 yr; suspected Crohn's disease; paroxysmal recurrent fever; intestinal symptoms; no oral or genital ulcers

All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

phenotype_specificity.statement: Person-level: recurrent fever and intestinal symptoms with suspected Crohn's disease. Whether other genes were tested is not stated for this patient.

functional.statement: No assay result for this specific variant is stated in the text of 40574834. The paper says newly identified variants were tested with an NF-kB reporter assay in A20-deficient HEK293 cells (construct) and shown in Figure 2, and that diagnosis required functional confirmation, but the figure's variant labels are not in the text available here. These quotes are cohort-level.

quotes.quote: The results of functional analyses of newly identified TNFAIP3 variants are shown in Figure 2 and Supplementary Figure 2.
The diagnosis of HA20 was confirmed via functional analysis of the TNFAIP3 variant.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Frameshift (1-nt deletion), predicted p.(Ser507AlafsTer190) per the batch HGVS. The paper attributes the disease to heterozygous loss-of-function variants.

quotes.quote: A20 haploinsufficiency (HA20) is a hereditary autoinflammatory disease caused by heterozygous loss-of-function variants in the TNFAIP3 gene (1).
All 54 patients analyzed had heterozygous variants in TNFAIP3, comprising a total of 35 distinct pathogenic variants.

concerns: Survey table only; no case description for this person.
Paper writes c.1518delC; the batch writes c.1518del (same position).
Which variants appear in Figure 2 (reporter assay) is not readable from the text.
notes_for_panel: Single individual from a registry survey. Family 29 has one patient listed; the pedigree figure text does not show other carriers legibly.
